Tom — thanks again for the draft MSA. We're starting intake on our side and want to clarify a few items so contracting can move quickly. See questions and asks below; I flagged the relevant sections in the attached doc (Clearwave_MSA_v1.docx).

High-level asks:
- Please confirm the counterparty legal name and signatory for the Order Form (we have "Clearwave Systems, Inc.").
- Data residency: do you require EU or APAC locations for any production dataset? If yes, which regions and which accounts are affected?
- Privacy appendix / DPA: we reviewed the attached DPA and have one ask to add our KMS integration language and an exception for customer-managed keys in Appendix B.
- Billing: we need billing contact and preferred invoice cadence; also confirm whether they want proration for pilot months.

Quick next steps: if you can return a redline of the MSA with those clarifications, legal will triage and we can aim for a single round of counters.

Kimberly — appreciate the thorough list. Quick answers inline:
- Legal name: "Clearwave Systems, Inc."; signatory will be our VP of Finance (I can confirm the exact name tomorrow).
- Data residency: we prefer US-only for pilot; we have EU customers but not on this contract. If EU is needed later we expect a follow-on SOW.
- DPA / KMS: we'll review your KMS language; our security team typically requests that customer-managed keys be limited to export controls and cannot be used to disable logging. Are you able to scope the KMS exception narrowly?
- Billing: billing contact is finance@clearwave.com. They prefer monthly invoices net-30 and request proration for pilots.

Tom — thanks for the redline and the quick answers. We can provide a copy of our SOC 2 Type II report within 3 business days; we'll redact internal-only contact info. Regarding the DPA Appendix B, proposed wording attached (short excerpt in-line):

"Customer-managed keys permitted only for encryption-at-rest; keys must be escrowed with Redwood for audit purposes and may not be used to suppress telemetry or access logs. Customer keys will not be used to obviate compliance logging or legal hold requests."

On inference logs: for pilot we'll accept a 30-day retention of raw inference logs. For retention past 30 days we propose providing aggregated metrics or anonymized logs unless otherwise scoped in a follow-on SOW.

Jordan — can you please attach the updated OrderForm_Draft.xlsx and mark billing contact? Marissa, thanks for setting the security call — we'll attend.
